summary.text: Mark Zatezalo is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 2, listed with Hancock County. His legislative page lists him as vice chair of the Energy and Public Works Committee.

paragraphs.text: Zatezalo's page gives his birth date as March 16, 1952, and his birthplace as Steubenville, Ohio.
It lists a B.S. in geology from West Virginia University (1974) and a master's in geology from the University of Missouri (1977), and gives his occupation as hydrogeologist.
It names his spouse as Martha and lists two children, Jennifer and Danica.
Zatezalo also serves on the House's Appropriations, Banking and Insurance and Finance committees.
